note: Bots and intents, the version label that addresses neither, and the delete that is not an error.

superseded_members.bots[0].checksum: The pack answered GetBots with the whole stored bot record, including its locale and its checksum. BotMetadata declares neither -- it carries name, status, version, description and the two dates -- so they were members no SDK could read off a listed bot. The bundle still stores both, because GetBotResponse does declare them and the recording shows GetBot answering them; it projects the listed item down to what BotMetadata carries. Every other member of these steps is still compared.
